did: Built the server half of asking home to redo part of a render. Run again on Couldn't finish moves a failed video back into the worker's queue. An episode's thumbnail can be made on its own, as one asset job in the render worker's single lane, and placed whole so it never overwrites or half-writes a file. A failed render now names the scenes and takes that stopped it, from the recorder's own words or the essay's chapters, and never shows a bare id. A list of names is all or nothing, cut to the same twelve scenes the worker keeps, and a name can't hide or reorder its text.

calls.title: How big a refusal file the board reads
options: Raise the ceiling to 32 KiB so twelve scene names fit
Keep 2 KiB and drop names that don't fit
calls.why: The worker keeps up to twelve names of 480 characters. The largest such file is about 25 KB, and dropping names unpredictably would break the all-or-nothing rule.
calls.undo: Lower REFUSED_CEILING in feeds/renders.rs and cap the worker's names to match.

calls.title: A name built from the essay that holds a hidden or reordering character
options: Strip the character and keep the name
calls.why: It is the same rule as for the recorder's names, and stripping would show a name that differs from the essay's words.
calls.undo: Change shown() in cards_essays/names.rs to filter characters instead of refusing.

left: A one-off failure in interview_weeks' a_send_is_a_draft_and_the_record_names_each_silence test passed on every rerun, so I didn't file it. A session that sees it again should.
The board takes scene names of at most 160 characters, while the worker keeps up to 480. A longer name leaves the whole list unnamed, which is safe but shows fewer names.
